On August 10, 2026, Silence Therapeutics plc (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing positive topline results from the Phase 2 SANRECO trial of divesiran in polycythemia vera (“PV”).

On August 10, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing positive topline results from the Phase 2 SANRECO trial, a 36-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled portion of the Phase 2 trial evaluating divesiran (6 mg/kg) administered subcutaneously every six weeks (“Q6W”) or every twelve weeks (“Q12W”) met its primary endpoint and secondary endpoints.
